_comment: Arm B conventional-memory corpus for the micro pack: unverified text blobs a plain RAG store would serve. One blob per domain (ConventionalMemoryAgent picks the first hit for the domain). Each blob is written so that following it blindly is the archetypal mistake of its scenario family - no verification gate, which is precisely what arm C adds via the surface.
